lina (docs): heads-up: i'm drafting a compact decision matrix for quantization profiles to sit on the Optimize toolkit page. sketch attached in thread below. want to confirm examples we should include (chat gen, short prompts, embed-heavy, batch inference).
jess (docs): love this. can we keep the matrix to 3 rows (latency-sensitive, cost-sensitive, quality-sensitive) and 3 columns (4-bit, 8-bit, float16) so it's scannable? also add a short example command for each cell.
owen (eng-ml): that layout works. for the 4-bit cell we should call out potential hallucination risk on long-form completions. recommend `qprofile="4bit-aggressive"` for short-turn chat and `qprofile="8bit-balanced"` for longer contexts.
lina (docs): noted. thinking of adding tiny snippets like:```python
# short turn chat: prefer aggressive 4-bit
client.generate(prompt, model="redwood-rlhf-1", qprofile="4bit-aggressive", max_tokens=48)
```
jess (docs): include an embed example too:```python
emb = client.embed(texts, model="embedder-v2", qprofile="8bit-balanced")
```
rita (qa): QA request: can we add a test that renders the table and validates example commands parse with the docs linter? i caught a couple of broken inline code blocks last week.
owen (eng-ml): good call. i'll add a tiny fixture that runs the example snippets with a dry-run SDK flag (no remote calls). we should also add a one-sentence note about when to avoid quantization (safety/classification workloads).
jess (docs): agree. also add a backlink to the Optimize toolkit "when to use cache vs prefetch" section, but avoid hardcoding paths; use the `{{ site.link('opt:cache-guide') }}` style so it's resilient.
ci-bot: new PR opened by lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901  title: docs: add qprofile decision matrix + examples 
lina (docs): PR includes: 1) decision matrix table, 2) three example snippets (chat, embed, batch), 3) one-liner on quantization caveats, 4) test fixture for snippet rendering.
owen (eng-ml): can you add a short rationale comment for each qprofile in the matrix (one sentence)? helps readers choose.
jess (docs): and a short changelog entry under /opt/release-notes so PMs see it. lina can do in follow-up.
lina (docs): will add after merge. rita, would you mind running the test matrix on your pass?
rita (qa): yes, I'll run the snippet linter + doc render locally. will report back with failures.
lina (docs): thanks team. aiming to merge after CI green and QA thumbs up. :rocket:
